mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods where FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods where UNRATE remains below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP and housing starts indicate strong economic growth, which may boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods where GDPC1 and HOUST both show positive growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, which may lead to higher equity prices over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 1% in the last month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate may signal tighter monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and investment, and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.1pp in the last month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods where FEDFUNDS increases by >0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment and falling payroll employment suggests economic weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation as measured by CPI may lead to tighter monetary policy, decreasing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 300.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low unemployment and high retail sales signal strong consumer demand, which may boost equity markets and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods where UNRATE is low and RSAFS is high.
